IGUI_LCCQF_Dialog_Start: You do not look local. If you came to talk, talk. I am not going anywhere yet.
IGUI_LCCQF_Dialog_WorkOffer: I do have something. There is an old checkpoint not far from here. I will mark the place on your map. Reach it, look around, then come back to me.
IGUI_LCCQF_Dialog_WorkAccepted: Good. The checkpoint is marked on your map. Reach the place, then return to me.
IGUI_LCCQF_Dialog_WorkActive: The checkpoint is still waiting. Check your map, reach the marked place, then come back.
IGUI_LCCQF_Dialog_SupplyOffer: There is another job. Thin out a few infected, find two sheets, clear the roadside point I mark, and bring the sheets back to me.
IGUI_LCCQF_Dialog_SupplyAccepted: Start with the infected. After that find two sheets. The roadside point will be marked when it becomes relevant, then bring the sheets back to me.
IGUI_LCCQF_Dialog_SupplyActive: Finish the current step. Your quest log has the exact objective and progress.
IGUI_LCCQF_Dialog_SupplyCompleted: Good. The road is quieter and the supplies are here. That job is finished.
IGUI_LCCQF_Dialog_Who: Call me Alexey. To the server I am a test NPC; to you I am the first person this system can talk through.
IGUI_LCCQF_Quest_Checkpoint_Description: Alexey asked you to reach the old checkpoint marked on your world map and then return to him.
IGUI_LCCQF_Quest_SupplyRun_Description: Alexey wants the nearby infected reduced, two sheets collected, a roadside point cleared, and the supplies delivered back to him.
